content.text:
Existing PID file found during start.
Removing/clearing stale PID file.
Tomcat started.
api restarted 10:52:22

observation.command:
cp /tmp/dist/web/xplan-manager-api.war /tmp/dist/web/xplan-validator-api.war /tmp/dist/web/xplan-dokumente-api.war /opt/tomcat-api/webapps/
unset CATALINA_PID; source /etc/xplanbox.env
/opt/tomcat-api/bin/shutdown.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 8
for p in $(ps aux | grep "[c]atalina.base=/opt/tomcat-api" | awk '{print $2}'); do kill "$p" 2>/dev/null; done; sleep 4
CATALINA_PID=/opt/tomcat-api/tomcat.pid /opt/tomcat-api/bin/startup.sh; echo "api restarted $(date +%H:%M:%S)"
